transcript:
User: Make it quick, I'm on a job site. Forty-five seconds.
Agent: Got it, I’ll be quick.  

We help businesses stop losing money from missed calls by answering every call, booking jobs, and sending you the details while you’re working — is that something you’re running into right now, missing calls while you’re on site?
User: Yes, I miss about 25 calls a week. What's your solution? Keep it short.
Agent: Makes sense, that’s a lot of work walking away.  

We give you a 24/7 phone assistant that answers those calls like a receptionist, captures the lead, books the job or appointment, and texts/emails you the details instantly so you don’t lose the customer — do you mainly want it to book jobs for you, or just capture and qualify the leads?
User: Book jobs, capture leads, whatever. Bottom line: will it make me money? Time's ticking.
Agent: Totally get it — yes, this is built to make you money, not be a gadget.  

If we turn those 25 missed calls a week into booked site visits and real quotes, even a couple extra jobs a month usually more than pays for it — are you open to a quick 15‑minute call with Jay later today or tomorrow so he can show you real numbers for contractors?
User: Sure, if Jay's fast. Tomorrow, 7 AM Eastern. Number's +13055550003. No fluff, just straight to the point.
Agent: Got it, I’ll let Jay know you want a quick, straight-to-the-point call tomorrow at 7 AM Eastern on this number, and he’ll walk you through exactly how this can turn those missed calls into booked jobs. Nothing else from my side right now—have a good one on site today.
